name: Necklace of Fireballs

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

last.text: falls apart, its last bead thrown

powers.name: Throw beads
powers.text: Magic action: throw one or more beads up to 60 ft: a level 3 Fireball (save DC 15), one level higher per extra bead.

summary: 1d6 + 3 beads: throw one as a Fireball (save DC 15), or several at once for a bigger one.
text: This necklace has 1d6 + 3 beads hanging from it. You can take a Magic action to detach a bead and throw it up to 60 feet away. When it reaches the end of its trajectory, the bead detonates as a level 3 Fireball (save DC 15). You can hurl multiple beads, or even the whole necklace, as one Magic action. When you do so, increase the level of the Fireball by 1 for each bead beyond the first.
